# Code of conduct

- Criticize the work, not the person. "This change makes the snare click at a short decay" helps. "This is obviously wrong" doesn't.
- Report what you saw: the version, the plugin or the FM-1, and what you did.
- Don't push anyone to flash firmware onto a device they can't afford to lose.
- No harassment or personal attacks.
- Don't post other people's kits without permission, or anyone's personal information.

To report a problem, use "Report content" in the `···` menu of the issue, pull request or comment. The maintainer can hide comments, lock threads and block accounts.
